messages:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up from the DNS/LB incident. Root cause: synchronized cross-region failover + low DNS TTLs -> retry amplification and TLS handshake spikes. Need owners and timeboxes for DNS TTL change, routing jitter, TLS backoff, and probes.

emily: I'll own the synthetic probe + dashboard. Plan: dual-region probe that measures retries/sec and handshake-fail%. Canary tomorrow 07:00 UTC.

cho: I'll take routing changes (jitter + cooldown). Proposal: instance-level jitter 0-6s + cluster cooldown 30s behind feature flag. Proto in staging in 48h.

netops: I'll handle DNS/registrar. Proposal: increase edge TTL 30s -> 120s, open registrar ticket, and add rollback steps. Target: EOD Thu. Adding runbook snippet to postmortem.

sre-oncall: Alerting plan: retries/sec > 2x baseline for 5m -> page oncall and mute rollout. Gating: probe green + canary metrics within 15% before prod.

sam: TLS action: add exponential backoff on TLS handshake retries (max 3 attempts, base 200ms) and verify cert-cache behavior on edge proxies. Who pairs?

netops: I'll pair with cho on proxy cert-cache and handshake backoff. Will add tests.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy triggered for PR #912 (cho). status: queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

emily: I'll create saved query for weekly recurrence-watch (6 weeks) and own weeks 1-2. Adding calendar invite.

cho: Will include PR link + test harness in the postmortem. Feature flag routing.jitter.enabled and immediate disable switch.

sam: Ownership recap: DNS TTL -> netops (EOD Thu); routing jitter -> cho (staging 48h); probe/dashboard -> emily (canary 07:00 UTC); TLS backoff -> netops+cho (sync tomorrow). Please add PR links + rollback plan in doc.

emily: Agreed. I'll post probe dashboard link after canary.

sre-oncall: If probe alerts during canary, we'll auto-abort and page.

sam: Thanks everyone — marking these as action items in the postmortem. Close once PRs merge and probes stable. :white_check_mark:
